This file says which probe cells of scripts/audit/routing-drift.mjs a row of scripts/eval/DECISIONS.md speaks for.
how_to_edit: Keys of `rows` are row ids: `node scripts/audit/routing-drift.mjs --rows`. A row gets `probes` (selectors: fn ocr | translate | gate | constant; language a name, a list or "*"; optional visibility [visible | new | hidden backlog], provider [none | bph], period, hand [manuscript | print]; `expect` is what the row says the router does there) or `not_routing` with the reason the three routing functions cannot show it. A translate selector without `provider` means a book with no provider. Every DECIDED row must be here; a row of another status may be, so that finding (b) can name the row that proposed a branch. Editing a row's Stratum or Question cell changes its id: move the entry.
